entries.title: Tell HN: Can we stop commenting on troll comments?
entries.author: tptacek
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Can we stop commenting on troll comments?
entries.excerpt: We're definitely seeing more overt troll comments lately. I'm not talking about baiting the Apple fanboys or spouting political talking points; I'm talking about comments with Slashdot "first-post" type nonsense. That's not a big deal. The problem is, people here seem to feel compelled to point out to the troll that this is the "wrong site" to post to. They don't care. Who does care?
